svg.title: XC7Z010-CLG400 ball map
svg.text: XC7Z010-CLG400: balls used by the design
Top view, ball A1 at the top left. Label = signal, small text = ball and bank. Grey grid = ball exists (PL bank 34 / 35 light blue, PS banks 500/501 light yellow, power and config white).
PS MIO: SD0 boot card, UART1 console
